# User guide

Recovery of homoeologous loci from target capture data in higher ploidy samples.

To get started first [install](01-Setup/01-installation.qmd) and [setup](01-Setup/02-env_setup.qmd) NextPyper environemnts.

To run NextPyper, you will need to [prepare your probes](02-Getting-started/01-prep_probes.qmd), and [prepare your samples](02-Getting-started/02-prep_samples.qmd). Afterwards, 

Then [running NextPyper](02-Getting-started/03-running.qmd) should be easy.
